issue.title: bob ref retitle: title, matching H1, and reading-task link alias in one previewed cross-note write

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (note #15, F6 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent.

Add `bob ref retitle <ref> <TITLE>`: one previewed, atomic, cross-note write that updates the reference's `title:`, its matching first body H1, and the link alias of its reading task (the `#task #ref` line wherever it lives). Follow bob's usual preview, apply, and undo envelope, and note that marker-synced fields reach the PDF marker at the next writing scan (decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated). Then switch the Reference editor's Title row (bob-plugins 249v plus 298w settings rows) to this verb under a new capability, keeping today's `bob props` `setting.set title` path (single-note title plus matching-H1 retitle, with a reading-task link-text effect) as the fallback.

Today, a Title edit through `bob props` retitles only the reference note itself, which bob-cli-qp.1 added as a deliberate frontmatter-plus-H1 exception. It reports the reading-task link text as an effect rather than writing it, so the task line keeps the old title until a later sync.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Ref Cards plan made cross-note title writes explicitly out of scope; bob props writes one note. A retitle verb is a new bob ref command contract plus a plugin capability.

issue.creation_reason: The Reference editor's Title row can only retitle the reference note itself, so the reading task's link alias goes stale; Ref Cards follow-up F6 asks for one cross-note verb.
